scripts.generate:openapi: bun run scripts/dev.ts cargo run -p koharu-rpc --bin openapi -- ui/openapi.json
scripts.generate:api: bun run generate:openapi && bun run --filter ui generate:api && bun run format:generated
scripts.check:generated: bun run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- ui/openapi.json ui/lib/api/generated.ts ui/lib/api/schemas
